n89b00f3241.headline: US, Iran weigh ceasefire plan as Trump deadline nears
n89b00f3241.summary: The US and Iran have received a ceasefire plan as President Donald Trump threatens to unleash hell if Tehran does not act. Both sides are weighing the proposal.
n89b00f3241.why: Middle East ceasefire talks affect oil supply risk, shipping routes and broader market sentiment.

nf4ce3c4bf9.headline: April 6, 2026
nf4ce3c4bf9.summary: The Romanian government adopted a second package of fuel market interventions after capping commercial markups on gasoline and diesel from April 1. It also cut the excise duty on standard diesel.
nf4ce3c4bf9.why: Fuel taxes and price caps directly affect inflation, transport costs and fuel retailers in the country.

n06c3fe45e7.headline: RC lifts the lid on fuel prices hike, saying storage depots don’t meet domestic demand
n06c3fe45e7.summary: Dar es Salaam Regional Commissioner Albert Chalamila outlined factors behind rising fuel prices, saying storage depots do not meet domestic demand.
n06c3fe45e7.why: Fuel prices feed into transport and food costs, so supply bottlenecks affect inflation and household spending in Tanzania.

nfaf5c2c6e0.headline: Fresh measures to keep fuel prices at bay
nfaf5c2c6e0.summary: Romania's government approved a second package of fuel-market measures, including a 0.36 RON cut in standard diesel excise from April 7, after capping diesel and petrol markups.
nfaf5c2c6e0.why: Government intervention in fuel taxes and margins affects pump prices, inflation and fiscal revenue in Romania.

n880fc995fc.headline: Younger Hungarian voters spurn Orban, some say they will leave if he is re-elected
n880fc995fc.summary: Voters who came of age under Prime Minister Viktor Orban have emerged as a key group driving support for the opposition ahead of a pivotal election. Some say they will leave if he is re-elected.
n880fc995fc.why: Hungary's election outcome shapes EU relations, fiscal policy and investor sentiment toward Hungarian assets.

naaf9e76e83.headline: Iran's Grip On Strait of Hormuz Tightens As US Intelligence Warns Tehran Unlikely To Relinquish Control: Report
naaf9e76e83.summary: Fresh US intelligence reports indicate Iran is unlikely to reopen the critical waterway soon. The report describes Iran's control of the strait as its most powerful lever.
naaf9e76e83.why: The Strait of Hormuz is a key chokepoint for seaborne oil, so disruptions there feed directly into global crude prices and shipping costs.
naaf9e76e83.why_moved: Reports that Iran is unlikely to reopen the Strait of Hormuz soon point to prolonged restriction of a major oil chokepoint, which tends to lift crude prices.

n1b3abc016d.headline: Why Aussies will face months of high costs
n1b3abc016d.summary: Australians are warned that fuel, grocery and interest costs could stay high for months, even if the US-led conflict with Iran ended tomorrow. The warning points to lingering cost pressures.
n1b3abc016d.why: Persistent inflation and rate pressure shape household spending, consumer equities and Reserve Bank of Australia policy expectations.

n4431a57de4.headline: Rwanda threatens to stop protecting US gas project from ISIS over sanctions
n4431a57de4.summary: Rwanda is threatening to withdraw troops protecting a US gas project from Islamic State in Mozambique over new sanctions. The project's security depends on that deployment.
n4431a57de4.why: Mozambique's gas developments are large LNG investments, and security risks there affect project timelines and financing.

nbc503aaeb8.headline: Veg Thali Cost Stable, Non-Veg Thali Cheaper In March 2026 As Chicken Prices Fall: Crisil Report
nbc503aaeb8.summary: Crisil Intelligence said veg thali costs were flat in March 2026, offset by cheaper vegetables and pulses against higher tomato, oil and LPG prices. Non-veg thali costs fell 1% on lower chicken prices.
nbc503aaeb8.why: Crisil is an Indian research and ratings firm whose monthly thali index tracks household food inflation, a key input for India's central bank rate decisions.

n5077a2096a.headline: Morgan Stanley says US stock correction largely done. Rates the final hurdle before higher
n5077a2096a.summary: Morgan Stanley's view leans constructive for equities, favouring cyclicals and large-cap tech, but it keeps rates as the main hurdle. The note frames the correction as largely complete.
n5077a2096a.why: Morgan Stanley is a major US investment bank whose equity strategy research is widely followed by institutional investors.

nd4604dfed0.headline: US and Iran receive peace proposal as Trump vows 'hell' if Strait stays shut
nd4604dfed0.summary: The US and Iran received the framework of a plan to end hostilities, but Iran immediately rejected reopening the Strait of Hormuz. Trump vowed 'hell' if the Strait stays shut.
nd4604dfed0.why: The Strait of Hormuz is a major chokepoint for global oil shipments, so disruptions there feed directly into crude prices.
nd4604dfed0.why_moved: Iran rejected immediate reopening of the Strait while the US threatened action, leaving shipping through the chokepoint uncertain.

nd809505172.headline: Indian companies' $3.7 billion NDF hoard shows firms seized rupee arbitrage window
nd809505172.summary: Activity in India's non-deliverable forwards market surged past $3.7 billion on March 30, around four times the average, signalling a rush to capture arbitrage.
nd809505172.why: Non-deliverable forwards are offshore-settled currency hedges used by companies to manage rupee exposure and arbitrage pricing gaps.

n81616253cd.headline: Inflation fears could push Fed to raise interest rates, key official says
n81616253cd.summary: A top official warned that inflation fears could lead the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates at a potential move later this week.
n81616253cd.why: The Federal Reserve sets US benchmark interest rates, which influence borrowing costs across the global financial system.
n81616253cd.why_moved: Warnings that inflation is accelerating again raise the prospect of tighter Federal Reserve policy, which tends to lift bond yields.

na81704b5f5.headline: Reserve Bank of India clears Emirates NBD’s stake purchase in RBL Bank
na81704b5f5.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has cleared Emirates NBD's purchase of a stake in RBL Bank. RBL would be treated as a foreign bank operating through a subsidiary structure, with Emirates NBD as the overseas parent.
na81704b5f5.why: RBL Bank is a private-sector Indian lender, and Emirates NBD is a Dubai-based bank with a large international footprint. Foreign ownership approvals shape how Indian banks attract overseas capital.

ndae4a02315.headline: Bitcoin and ethereum price today, Tuesday, April 7, 2026: Prices trend down as traders await war deadline
ndae4a02315.summary: Bitcoin and ether opened at $68,860.46 and $2,107.45 on Tuesday, both lower than the previous day. Both trended down Tuesday morning.
ndae4a02315.why: Bitcoin is the largest cryptocurrency by market value and trades around the clock. Its price often reacts to shifts in global risk sentiment.

nbb639cd91c.headline: TDI Infratech to invest Rs 750 cr on 150-acre township project in Ludhiana, Punjab
nbb639cd91c.summary: Realty firm TDI Infratech said it will invest Rs 750 crore to develop a 150-acre township in Ludhiana, Punjab, as part of its expansion plan.
nbb639cd91c.why: TDI Infratech is an Indian real estate developer, and its project pipeline reflects demand in India's housing and township market.

n52fa8aec3d.headline: Saudi Arabia Raises Crude Premium To Record $19.50 For Asia May Deals
n52fa8aec3d.summary: Saudi Arabia has raised its Arab Light crude premium for Asian buyers to a record $19.50 per barrel for May contracts. The increase is expected to raise costs for import-dependent countries such as India.
n52fa8aec3d.why: Saudi Arabia is the world's largest crude exporter, and its official selling prices set the terms for much of Asia's crude purchases. Premium changes feed directly into refiners' costs and regional inflation.
n52fa8aec3d.why_moved: The premium increase raises the cost of Saudi crude for Asian importers, as the input states. It is a direct change to official pricing for a major supply source.

n2a9e2fe31c.headline: Indonesia moves to unify state banks’ asset management units – report
n2a9e2fe31c.summary: Indonesia is moving to unify the asset management units of its state-owned banks. The stated aim is a single asset management group to compete in Indonesia and across the region.
n2a9e2fe31c.why: State-owned banks are central to Indonesia's financial system, and consolidation of their asset management arms would reshape a major block of domestic fund management.

n2239f7520b.headline: Australia services PMI falls into contraction as costs surge, demand weakens
n2239f7520b.summary: Australia's services PMI fell into contraction as costs surged and demand weakened, pointing to slowing growth alongside rising inflation pressures.
n2239f7520b.why: The services PMI is a monthly survey of business activity that signals economic momentum and inflation pressure, which shape central bank policy.

n3786d68a56.headline: US regulator ends probe into Tesla's 'actually smart summon' feature after software fixes
n3786d68a56.summary: The US regulator ended its probe into Tesla's Actually Smart Summon feature after software fixes, with incidents linked to minor property damage and no reported injuries.
n3786d68a56.why: Tesla is a large electric vehicle maker, and its driver-assistance software faces ongoing regulatory scrutiny that can affect costs and sales.

impacts.name: Tesla
impacts.why: Closing the probe removes a regulatory investigation into a feature deployed in about 2.59 million vehicles.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

na4b27e6d51.headline: Crude oil soars as Mideast conflict chokes supply routes, Hormuz disruption stokes  panic
na4b27e6d51.summary: Strait of Hormuz closure is disrupting Mideast oil exports and refiners are seeking alternatives. OPEC+ agreed a modest output rise, but the war limits actual increases.
na4b27e6d51.why: The Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of the world's seaborne oil, so disruptions there quickly affect global crude prices and refining margins.
na4b27e6d51.why_moved: Closure of the Strait of Hormuz is disrupting Mideast oil exports, and the article describes the disruption as stoking panic in crude markets.

n69b8d6c2fa.headline: IMF Urges Pakistan to Remove Fuel Price Distortions
n69b8d6c2fa.summary: The International Monetary Fund asked Pakistan to remove distortions in petroleum pricing as soon as possible. The request came even after the IMF tacitly accepted a Rs. 152 adjustment.
n69b8d6c2fa.why: The IMF oversees Pakistan's lending programme, and its conditions on fuel pricing affect fiscal policy and inflation expectations.

nf69b42a750.headline: BOK chief nominee's heavy overseas assets raise eyebrows
nf69b42a750.summary: Bank of Korea governor nominee Shin Hyun-song drew scrutiny over his sizeable overseas assets, which could raise potential conflicts of interest. The nomination is pending.
nf69b42a750.why: The Bank of Korea sets the country's monetary policy, so the governor's independence and conflict-of-interest rules shape rate expectations and confidence in the won.

n2d398847aa.headline: Japanese Household Spending February 2026 softens m/m and falls y/y
n2d398847aa.summary: Japanese household spending in February 2026 softened month on month and fell year on year. Finance Minister Katayama also commented on very volatile FX markets.
n2d398847aa.why: Household spending is a key gauge of domestic consumer demand, which shapes Bank of Japan policy and the outlook for the yen.

ne4f355b4cf.headline: Local Wheels Show Smooth Moves on Country Roads
ne4f355b4cf.summary: Indian carmakers are reclaiming the home market from foreign rivals, marking a notable shift in competition in the world's third-largest passenger vehicle market.
ne4f355b4cf.why: India is the world's third-largest passenger vehicle market, so shifts in market share affect global automakers' growth strategies. Domestic carmakers' gains matter for listed Indian auto stocks.

nbf5a23ab30.headline: Xiao-I Corp Stock Explodes 157% as China Court Victory Over Apple Patent Bolsters AI Patent Portfolio
nbf5a23ab30.summary: Shares of Xiao-I Corp jumped more than 150% to around $0.34 as retail investors bought the micro-cap AI company after a legal victory over Apple in China.
nbf5a23ab30.why: Xiao-I is a small-cap artificial intelligence company with a China-focused business, and its patent position is a key part of its valuation. Micro-cap stocks are often highly volatile on news.
nbf5a23ab30.why_moved: Shares surged after a China court victory in the long-running patent dispute with Apple, which bolstered the company's AI patent portfolio, and retail investors bought heavily.

n694129383e.headline: Electricity Prices Up by Staggering 155% in Pakistan in Just 3 Years
n694129383e.summary: Electricity prices in Pakistan have increased by 155% over the last three years. A growing number of consumers are shifting to solar energy as a result.
n694129383e.why: Power tariffs shape industrial costs and household energy choices, and the shift to rooftop solar affects utilities and energy demand.
